sources.excerpt: Odious Fuzz Octave – Bowman Audio Endeavors Skip to content Just added to your cart Qty: View cart ( ) Continue shopping Submit Close search Search Log in Cart 0 items Home Current Endeavors Used Gear Emporium Home Current Endeavors Used Gear Emporium Odious Fuzz Octave Regular price $150.00 Sale price $150.00 Regular price Sale Sold out Unit price / per  Default Title - Sold out Error Quantity must be 1 or more Sold out     Adding product to your cart Odious Fuzz/Octave The fuzz side is the BAE Satans fingers. Satans Fingers is a finely tuned Silicon Transistor fuzz pedal. With two control parameters Volume & Fuzz, you can dial in the nasally spit, reminiscent of your favorite smiley face without having to ride your guitars volume knob. Or the sweet spot between tight compressed fuzz and a total blown out mess. The octave side adds a set ring mod/one octave up to the mix! Taking your already saturated fuzz to a gnarly (but tasty) land of fuzzed out, ring mod, octave up state of true filling aching bliss. The separate foot-switches allow the Octave side to be added to any effect in your chain, with or without using the Fuzz side! Housed in a 125B sized, powder coated enclosure with UV printed graphics. Standard center-negative power supply, accepts 9V and requires 100mA of current.
